tools.name: search
tools.description: Search your knowledge base for relevant information. Use when the user asks about their saved documents, notes, or uploaded files. Returns relevant text passages ranked by relevance.

top_k.description: Number of results to return (max 50, default: 20)

tools.name: ingest_text
tools.description: Add text content to the knowledge base. Use to save notes, documentation, or any text the user wants to remember. Content is automatically chunked and indexed for later retrieval.

metadata.description: Optional metadata to attach to the ingested content

tools.name: list_namespaces
tools.description: List all namespaces in the knowledge base. Use to discover what knowledge domains are available before searching. Returns namespace details including filter_keys - the valid metadata keys you can use to filter searches in each namespace.

tools.name: list_documents
tools.description: List documents in the knowledge base. Use to see what content has been indexed. Supports pagination via next_key for large result sets.

next_key.description: Pagination token from previous response for fetching next page

tools.name: get_document
tools.description: Get metadata for a specific document by ID. Use to retrieve details about a document found in search results or document listing.
